query: SELECT DATE(createdAt) as date, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(amountUsd AS DECIMAL(12,2))), 0) as revenue FROM paymentRecords WHERE createdAt >= '2025-12-10' GROUP BY DATE(createdAt) ORDER BY DATE(createdAt) LIMIT 5;
